{{Quote|Eh... you don't look much like a miner, but then again we've been getting several strange folk comin' through this outpost of late. Several strange things goin' on 'round here too. Some funny times these days if you ask me.|Gardo Valdell, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GV" />}}
'''Gardo Valdell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he discovered the [[Geonosian Bio-Lab]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:GV" />
